about: Frozen 2026-11-10, written AFTER the accident-duty companion rule (the two earlier narrative sets are development sets now). Run ONCE, no tuning afterwards. Written by Claude (not a lawyer).
fled: I act for the owner of a goods carrier whose driver, after the vehicle crushed a pedestrian on the Solapur road, kept going and abandoned the vehicle ten kilometres away. The pedestrian died. The owner has been arrested as well. Which provisions apply to each of them and how do I get bail?

Early morning my client's pickup van collided head-on with a motorcycle on a ghat section. Both riders were killed. Our client was injured, was taken to hospital by villagers, and was arrested from the hospital. What are the likely charges and the bail grounds?
A truck driver knocked down a road-side vendor at dusk near Aurangabad and drove straight to the next town. The vendor's family say he was drunk. What charges does he face and can bail be got?

The accused, 19, rammed a stationary tractor-trolley on the expressway with his father's car and one of his friends died. He fled to his native village after the crash. Advise on the offences, his father's position as owner and bail.

My client's autorickshaw struck an old man at a junction. Bystanders say the driver looked back, saw the man on the road, and left. The man is in the ICU. What sections apply and what is the bail outlook?

A speeding jeep hit a group of pilgrims on the roadside; two died. The jeep was found abandoned and the driver is absconding, but its owner, my client, has been arrested. What is the owner's liability and the chances of bail?
others: My client, a transport company manager, is accused of forging fitness certificates for a fleet of buses and paying an RTO clerk to approve them. What offences apply and what are the bail grounds?
My client, a driver, is accused of stealing diesel from the tanker he was driving and selling it to a dhaba owner. He was arrested yesterday. Offences and bail?
My client, a bike-taxi rider, is accused of sexually harassing a woman passenger during the ride. He was arrested last night. What are the likely charges and bail grounds?
